Generation Litany

rev 23.6 — Colony Sovereignty & Fleet Settlements
After generation, use Hide Tools to collapse this entire litany and give the map, registers and selected records the full cartographic workspace. On phones this happens automatically after the first generation; tap ⚙ Generation Tools to restore it. 3D touch controls: one finger rotates/taps, two fingers pan/pinch/twist.
Generation Scale
Sector-scale overrides
Sub-sector mode uses the usual 2–8 systems within about a 10 ly radius. Sector mode defaults to a 192 ly cube (≈7.08 million cubic ly) containing 2–10 sub-sectors, but allows 1–40 for unusually sparse or enormous campaign sectors.
Identity & Naming
Core Stellar Overrides
Planetary & Optional Rules
Practical Errata resolves printed overlaps/gaps and percentage formula conflicts. Literal mode records the book's ambiguities in the roll ledger.
Stars of Inequity World Generator
Warhammer Planetary War Zone
Auto only assigns a published/BSData-derived army where the generated civilisation makes sense. Primitive worlds and unsupported xenos remain procedural.
The generator will not create more native troops than the generated polity can plausibly deploy. Mature, highly militarised colonies and Voidfarer/system empires can reach the tens-of-thousands range.
When present, Rangdan are generated as conquerors and subvertors, not isolated visitors. A domain can consume most systems in a sub-sector and may control the entire sub-sector.
HH1 catalogue integration: recognised 30k civilisations use compact embedded rosters derived from the archived BSData Horus Heresy 1st Edition catalogues. Rangdan use the standalone Rangdan_Confederacy_HH1.catz Sleeper Host catalogue. Optional wargear trees are condensed; procedural Rak’Gol/minor-xenos remain custom but are costed against HH1-sized unit packages.
Colonies, Settlements & Expeditionary Enclaves
Controls automatic additional settlements; manual additions remain available from each location.
The Rogue Trader layer now runs from System Creation through sentient population, planetside adventure seeds, treasure and colonial structure, with an optional HH1.0 / 7th Edition planetary-war layer attached to every generated world and Territory. It remains layered over the existing detailed astronomical generator, so the original orbit geometry, planet visuals, moons and 3D maps remain intact.
Primary Orbit Overrides
Force the primary star's orbit contents or names. Leave fields on Auto / blank to roll normally.
Source Fidelity Notes
The original detailed-star-system guide remains the physical astronomy layer. Stars of Inequity is now an additional interconnected rules layer: System Features → Rogue Trader Star/Solar Zones → System Elements → Planet Body → Gravity → Orbital Features → Atmosphere → Climate → Habitability/Landmasses → Territories → Resources → Landmarks → Notable Species → Inhabitants/Development → Warhammer 30k/40k War Zone → Planetary & System Warhosts → Chapter II Planetside Adventures → Chapter III Colony Characteristics, Resource interactions and operations.
Sub-sector placement and the interstellar “dead-space” layer are a setting expansion beyond the uploaded star-system book. Every individual system inside a generated sub-sector still uses the book-derived stellar and planetary procedure. Setting-specific void entries are marked separately as Cartographica / lore overlay data.
Fan-made utility. Fully self-contained: no network connection, remote libraries, fonts, images, or APIs are required for generation or 3D maps. It can run from a normal web host or directly from this HTML file in a modern mobile browser. No Games Workshop or Fantasy Flight Games art/assets are embedded.
